sn45.162:1.3: Seyyo ham asmīti vidhā || Sadiso ham asmīti vidhā || Hīno ham asmīti vidhā || ||
sn45.162:1.5: Imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave tissannaṃ vidhānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo || ||
sn45.162:1.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmim || ||
sn45.162:1.8: Imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave tissannaṃ vidhānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || ||
